beats.text: Qatar has 99.2 percent wage and salaried workers. In Chad, it is 8.4 percent.
Qatar is the world's highest. Almost every worker there has a formal employment contract.
Chad is the world's lowest. Most work for themselves without a steady, basic pay.
Side by side, Qatar has 12 times the share of paid employees in Chad.
These workers hold contracts for a basic pay that does not depend on business revenue.
Brazil has 69.7 percent. China has 62.3 percent.
Nigeria has 13.8 percent, Madagascar has 11.7 percent, and Niger 10.5 percent.
Do you have a formal employment contract?
